title: Darnassus
body: Darnassus is the capital of the night elves, raised in the high boughs of Teldrassil as a monument to their survival. Unlike the stone cities of men and dwarves it lies open to the sky, its terraces of craftsmen, warriors and traders spread among groves and paths around a quiet lake. High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind rules from the Temple of the Moon, Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm leads the druids from the Cenarion Enclave, and the two do not always agree.

title: Cenarion Enclave
body: In the northern reaches of Darnassus lies the Cenarion Enclave, home of the city's druids. Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm holds court in the great tree at its heart, and his second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, trains young druids below and answers the callers the Arch Druid would rather not see. Behind Fandral's tree lie heaps of soil carried from Un'Goro Crater for his research.

parts.body: From that soil grows morrowgrain, a mysterious herb Fandral gathers in great quantity to what end he does not say. Mathrengyl admits that simply standing near it makes him uneasy.

title: Temple of the Moon
body: The Temple of the Moon is the seat of the Sisters of Elune and the true center of power in Darnassus. At its heart a statue rises from a moonwell whose holy waters are said to purify and cleanse corruption, and Tyrande Whisperwind keeps her quarters on the upper level. Priestesses teach those who follow Elune and greet visitors with her blessing.

parts.body: Since the draenei of the Exodar joined the Alliance, the temple has welcomed new friends, and a draenei emissary teaches young mages within its walls.

An envoy of the Highborne, the night elf sorcerers long hidden in Eldre'Thalas, now waits by the moonwell for an audience with the high priestess, under the cold eye of a Sentinel who has not forgotten the War of the Ancients.

title: Tyrande Whisperwind
body: Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune, rules Darnassus from the Temple of the Moon. Ten thousand years ago she stood against Queen Azshara in the War of the Ancients, and through the long ages while the druids slept she led the Sentinels in guarding the forests. In the Third War she woke her beloved Malfurion Stormrage, freed his brother Illidan against his wishes and fought beside humans and orcs at Mount Hyjal.

parts.body: Malfurion is not at her side. After Hyjal he vanished, and his people do not know what became of him, so Tyrande rules alone while Fandral Staghelm leads the druids in his place.

title: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm
body: Fandral Staghelm is the Arch Druid of Darnassus. A thousand years ago he led the night elves against the Qiraji in Silithus, who named him Khar'sis, hand of the earth. After Hyjal he won the Circle of Ancients over and grew Teldrassil, hoping to win back his people's immortality. Proud and short of patience, he scorns idle visitors and says it was he, not Moonglade, who led his people out of darkness.

parts.body: The moonwell water of Teldrassil reaches him with the story of the tree's flawed growth, and he grumbles that its problems are a yoke he wishes he could soon be rid of.
